_meta.purpose: Per-route (domain_route) live baseline for the o/p eval layer. Compared against the latest rolling window in aggregator.route_regression_report. Tweak tolerances per-route when you know a route is naturally slow or volatile.

planner.evidence: calibrated from mock provider runs during shopstack development; real production numbers will be re-baselined after first 100 live calls
planner.notes: Planner is the primary route. Tolerances are loose while we collect real numbers.

market_lens.evidence: mock provider runs; vision is inherently more variable than text
market_lens.notes: Vision routes get looser latency tolerance (videos / images can be large).

ocr_receipt.evidence: Tesseract+hin: 0/15 Devanagari accuracy (from bench_baseline.json); GLM-OCR primary
ocr_receipt.notes: OCR success rate baseline reflects real-world photo variability. Expect frequent false positives that the pipeline self-corrects via fallback.

voice_add.evidence: SenseVoice baseline 0.248 WER on Hindi+English (from bench_baseline.json)
voice_add.notes: STT-driven. Success = transcribed text parsed into at least one inventory item.

shopping_list.evidence: planner tool calling baseline from bench_baseline.json
shopping_list.notes: Planner path with simpler prompt (create_or_update_shopping_list only).

add_purchase.evidence: planner tool calling baseline; single-tool invocation is easier than multi-tool
add_purchase.notes: Form-driven add purchase; rarely uses planner at all.

reconcile.evidence: planner tool calling baseline; reconciliation may chain multiple tools
